name: tmt
description: Toby Markdown Tickets — a lightweight, Git-tracked ticket tracker that lives in your repo as plain markdown files (thoughts/shared/tickets/). Owns the ticket envelope: sequential <PREFIX>-NNNN numbering, a status lifecycle with enforcement hooks, and create/update commands. Works standalone; pairs with the tce context-engineering workflow (which authors ticket content via /tce:ticket) as its native ticket backend.
